name: Mihishiro Shizuka
source:
A second-year student at Tatesuga Academy and captain of the archery club. She is the daughter of the family that runs Western Kanou Shrine and is the protagonist's childhood friend. Her grades are top of the class, and her outgoing personality lends itself to strong leadership.

[From [url=https://www.nookgaming.com/kagami-games-to-release-7-visual-novels-including-sakura-moyu/]NookGaming[/url]]
